description_en: Queries the attack payloads of intrusion events
description_zh: 获取入侵防御事件的攻击Payload
name: DescribeRiskEventPayload

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The source IP address to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events from the specified source IP address are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的源IP。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条源IP的入侵防御事件
parameters.name: src_ip

parameters.help_en: The destination IP address to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events with the specified destination IP address are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的目的IP。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条目的IP的入侵防御事件
parameters.name: dst_ip

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the intrusion event
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the firewall. Valid values:

VpcFirewall: virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall
InternetFirewall (default): Internet firewall
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙类型。取值：
VpcFirewall：表示VPC边界防火墙
InternetFirewall（默认）：表示互联网边界防火墙
parameters.name: firewall_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source VPC to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events that contain the specified ID of the source VPC are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的源VPC ID。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条源VPC ID的入侵防御事件
parameters.name: src_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination VPC to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events that contain the specified ID of the destination VPC are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的目的VPC ID。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条目的VPC ID的入侵防御事件
parameters.name: dst_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The public IP address. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events that contain the specified public IP address are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网资产IP。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条资产IP的失陷感知事件
parameters.name: public_ip

DstIP.description_en: The destination IP address of the intrusion event

DstPort.description_en: The destination port of the intrusion event

DstVpcId.description_en: The destination VPC ID of the intrusion event
DstVpcId.description_zh: 入侵防御事件的目的VPC ID

HitTo.description_en: The position where the hit ends

Payload.description_en: The attack payload of the intrusion event

PayloadLen.description_en: The length of the attack payload of the intrusion event
PayloadLen.description_zh: 入侵防御事件的攻击Payload长度

Proto.description_en:
The protocol type of intrusion event. Valid values:

TCP
UDP
Proto.description_zh:
入侵防御攻击事件的协议类型。取值：

TCP
UDP

SrcIP.description_en: The source IP address of the intrusion event

SrcPort.description_en: The source port of the intrusion event
SrcPort.description_zh: 入侵防御事件的源端口

SrcVpcId.description_en: The source VPC ID of the intrusion event
SrcVpcId.description_zh: 入侵防御事件的源VPC ID
